limitations: This is a fixed local image split, not a verified official or acquisition-disjoint protocol.
Sensor/polarization/date filename groups are unverified proxies, not recovered scene IDs.
Cross-split exact byte/RGB duplicates are excluded from lower-priority splits only.
Within-split duplicate images and differing source annotations are preserved, not adjudicated.
No near-duplicate or geographic/acquisition-independence claim is made.
The audit is not a claim that every original label is correct.
audit_gate.pixel_verification_scope: Duplicate rules independently recomputed from the reviewed SHA-bound full Pillow audit; every corresponding original image/label byte hash was rechecked, not a second decoded-pixel implementation.

unknown_source_group_metadata.hash_encoding: SHA256 of UTF8 compact sorted-key JSON; ordinal unique name lists; no trailing newline
unknown_source_group_metadata.meaning: Only existing missing sensor/polarization/date proxies in the fixed source are accepted; null is preserved, not converted into a scene or acquisition ID. No sample is excluded by this check.
